SH-29.title: Add story_type arm to JSON patch dispatch table
SH-29.acceptance_criteria: story set <id> --json '{"story_type":"..."}' must work, mirror --type flag behavior. Error message must list story_type as valid field. Unknown story_type values in JSON patch must be rejected with validation error. Tests: json_patch_sets_story_type, json_patch_rejects_invalid_story_type, json_patch_unknown_field_error_lists_story_type in tests/story_types.rs pass.
SH-29.design_section:
### app.rs — Command Handlers

- Type validation at write time: check slug exists in `load_type_map`
- `StoryTypeSet { at: String, story_type: String }` — new event variant mirroring `StoryPrioritySet`
- Error: `AppError::Validation` — `type \`{slug}\` is not defined. Available types: ...`
- JSON patch dispatch table in SetFields handler (app.rs:1884-1948)
- The new arm validates the value is a string, loads the type map via `storage::load_type_map(root)?`, rejects unknown types, emits `StoryEvent::StoryTypeSet`, pushes change string `format!("type -> {v}")`
- Error message at line 1948 updated to include `story_type` in valid fields list

SH-30.title: Make reserved slug 'none' check case-insensitive
SH-30.acceptance_criteria: story type add None and story type add NONE (any case variant) must be rejected as reserved. Existing lowercase 'none' rejection must continue working. Tests: type_add_none_titlecase_rejected, type_add_none_uppercase_rejected, type_add_none_mixedcase_rejected in tests/story_types.rs pass.
SH-30.design_section:
### storage.rs — Config Loading & Persistence

- `add_type(root, slug, description) -> Result<TypeDef>` — validates no duplicates, rejects reserved slugs ("none")
- Reserved slugs: "none" is forbidden in `add_type`
- Error: `AppError::Validation` — `type slug \`none\` is reserved`
- Line 419: `slug == "none"` → change to `slug.eq_ignore_ascii_case("none")`
- No other lines in storage.rs should be modified (the "default" check at line 424 is already correct)
